sections.text: مقدمة

This document out lines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated M6 in the above title block.

This Pump is used to transfer the 
 coolant water to condenser for condensing the steam from turbine to 
 condensate water and also transfer water for closed cooling system

sections.text: Pump out of Operation

Check the over heads clearance, and 
 compare it with the Setting values.

Check bolts fixation then re tight it 
 (if it is needed).

Grease the discharge valve of pump 
 (multi- purpose greases).

Check the Leakage from the glands and 
 flanges and treat it.
Repaint the Casing against rust.

Check and readjusted the gland for 
 stuffing box.

sections.text: Starting of the Pump

Before 
the Starting the Pump the Fool Awing Steps must be Checked

Open the cooling lines to gland and the 
 quantity of water is sufficient (8 10 GPM).
Check the direction of rotation of pump.
Check the level of sump.

Priming of the pump by filing the tunnel 
 between pump and condenser by screen travel pump.

Check the level of oil in baring of 
 driver.

Open the delivery valve gradually after 
 the pump has been started to operate at its full Speed.
